topic: Order coffee politely: "Could I get…" instead of "Give me…"

lines.text: Wait, is "Give me a latte" rude?
A little! Say "Could I get a latte, please" – it sounds friendly.
Could I get a large latte, please?
Kit's tip: could I get… is polite and friendly.
